**Finding: deviation (medium) — Section 12.4 (p0045)**

- **Issue:** The clause is a one-sided restriction on Customer only, and it is a **no-hire** ("solicit, hire, or employ"), covering **all** Vendor employees for **24 months** post-term, with the phrase "regardless of how the employee applies" affirmatively defeating any general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. This sits at the playbook walk-away line.
- **Internal conflict:** Section 12.3 has Vendor acknowledge that Customer "has made no ... no-hire commitment" and is free to hire "any person who responds to general recruitment" — directly contradicting 12.4.
- **Redline (validated, preferred):** delete Section 12.4, with the narrow mutual 12-month non-solicit (personnel directly involved in the Services, general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, no no-hire) offered as fallback in the comment.
